step.label: Receive incoming material shipments
step.description: Validate and log all inbound materials from vendors against purchase orders to establish baseline inventory for production launch.
step.useCase: Production planners need real-time visibility into material arrivals to confirm launch readiness.

step.label: Match procured materials to vendor contracts
step.description: Verify received materials align with procurement agreements and quality standards before warehouse acceptance.
step.useCase: Procurement officers must reconcile inbound shipments with negotiated contracts to prevent supply chain delays.

step.label: Screen hazardous substance compliance
step.description: Inspect and track any hazardous materials in the shipment to ensure storage, handling, and regulatory compliance.
step.useCase: Safety and compliance teams need confirmation that all received materials meet environmental and health regulations.

step.label: Assess engineering change impact on workforce
step.description: Analyze product design changes and engineering modifications to identify required workforce skill gaps and retraining needs.
step.useCase: HR and manufacturing leaders need data-driven insights on which employees require upskilling for the new production process.

step.label: Evaluate operational capability for product transition
step.description: Measure current operational capacity against new product requirements to identify process bottlenecks and capability gaps.
step.useCase: Operations directors must determine if existing production lines can handle the new product specifications without infrastructure investment.

step.label: Correlate employee safety risk with transition plan
step.description: Link safety risk assessments to employee roles and compensation tiers to ensure fair allocation of high-risk transition tasks.
step.useCase: HR business partners must balance fair compensation with safety protocols when assigning employees to new manufacturing roles.

step.label: Schedule employee capacity and time off adjustments
step.description: Coordinate sales team availability and adjust time-off schedules to ensure adequate staffing during product launch go-live period.
step.useCase: Sales operations managers need to block vacation time and confirm team capacity to support customer inquiries during launch.

step.label: Execute safety inspection campaign for launch readiness
step.description: Conduct comprehensive safety inspections across all production areas and supply chain touchpoints before commencing manufacturing.
step.useCase: EHS directors must certify that all facilities meet safety standards before authorizing production ramp-up.
